note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the communication and the sections of the termination clause are generic placeholders, never real contract text or notices. The before- and after-values are supplied cases of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); the thread only shows the link that is supplied, and the substitution changes nothing but that datum and its thread. No termination doctrine is stated: no ground or right to terminate, no notice period or time limit, no effect, no validity or sufficiency judgement, and no jurisdiction; "not described" is neutral (no thread, no conclusion). Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions and priorities.

presets.description: Substantive alternative (the reverse substitution): another contract, two sections; the case "not described" is replaced by "provided for" and a thread is drawn to section 1; a lower preferred magnification (2×).
